extracted.name: Country-Style Fried Potatoes
extracted.description: These fried potatoes seasoned with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder are cooked in shortening until golden brown for an easy breakfast side.
instruction_lines: Heat shortening in a large cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are golden brown. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Serve hot.
